scope: shared search engine and helper candidates only; eager/lazy end-to-end providers remain under audit

checks.pruning_soundness_completion_checks: all partial false outcomes checked against every completion
checks.lexicographic_find_model: matches first model from independent enumeration
checks.ownership_models: unique, fixed first variable zero, both blocks nonempty
checks.graph_constraints: six symbol pairs agree exactly with ownership equality
checks.witness_payloads: negative projection absent from the corresponding positive projection set
checks.baseline_loader: works after changing the process current directory
checks.incomplete_result_schema: incomplete status, null feasible count, lower-bound found count

static_findings: Expression evaluation follows the required three-valued semantics, including empty AND and OR.
Search uses the fixed canonical ownership order and only prunes partial assignments on a false constraint.
The direct projection record agrees with the immutable unpruned baseline on all reviewed examples.
Distinguisher families preserve exactly whether a block separates any tested negative-positive word pair.
No interface mismatch or third-party dependency was found.
limitations: These bounded checks review shared primitives; the eager and lazy providers still require whole-set differential audit over the frozen corpus.
The review does not establish a runtime or memory advantage.
The cooperative deadline is not a hard process kill; the audit runner must enforce the external per-input timeout.
